Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players make their way out to the middle. Shafali Verma and the debutant, Sabbhineni Meghana to open the batting for India Women. Lea Tahuhu to start with the ball.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, dropping Suzie Bates on 13 has cost India Women but the way they finished the innings would have given them momentum and confidence. The conditions are excellent for batting but there is movement on offer for the pacers with the new balls. Can India Women scale down the target? Do join us in a short while to find out.

Suzie Bates, the centurion, comes up for a quick chat. Says that it's nice to build some big partnerships. Expresses her disappointment that they didn't finish well but feels that 275 is still a good total. Mentions that they had to be a bit tight initially as there was some movement for the bowlers. Tells that hitting the stumps will be the key and she is backing her seamers to do the job here.

New Zealand Women got off to a good start, courtesy of an opening stand of 54 runs between Maddy Green and Suzie Bates. Once Green perished, it was Kerr who started scoring freely and took the pressure off Bates who played second fiddle. Amelia Kerr did get out in an attempt to maintain the scoring tempo but in came Amy Satterthwaite who changed the complexion of the innings. Both Amy and Bates started playing their shots and it was this partnership that helped the White Ferns get a bigger push in their run rate. Suzie Bates notched up her 11th ODI hundred while Amy Satterthwaite brought up her fifty in no time. They did lose wickets in a cluster at the end but they would have taken this score at the start of the innings.

Anyway, a good batting performance from New Zealand Women, thanks to Suzi Bates' fine knock of 106 runs and also a very fluent innings from Amy Satterthwaite. India Women were below-par in the field, dropping catches, and that could also cost them the game. However, they did pull things back nicely in the end overs after getting rid of well-set Suzie Bates. Rajeshwari Gayakwad stood out the most and the rest also did a decent job after a rusty beginning.

What a collapse for New Zealand Women! They were going along strongly and at the start of Powerplay 3, they were nicely positioned at 220/3. A strong finish was something we all expected but India Women bounced back at the backend and picked 7 wickets in no time to bundle them out. The way the hosts were batting, you can say, they have left 25-30 runs out there. Will that haunt them?

OUT! Soft dismissal! Loopy and full, around off and turning away, Kerr tries to go inside-out over covers but the ball takes the outer part and she ends up slicing it towards point. A simple catch for Sabbhineni Meghana, the debutant. New Zealand Women are all out for 275 and have wasted 11 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Sabbhineni Meghana b Rajeshwari Gayakwad

Commentary.Commentary: Around middle, on a length, Rowe works it away to mid-wicket. Dot ball to end Jhulan's spell.
Drifting down the leg side, Kerr clips it to square leg for a single.
Angling in, Rowe has played towards mid wicket for a single.
FOUR! A number 11 batter has nailed a straight drive. Fuller and around off, Hannah Rowe strides forward and creams it down the ground for a boundary.
Shout for an lbw! A length ball, around off and angling in, Rowe brings her bat down in defense close to her front pad. The bowler thinks that it's pad first but the umpire shakes his head.
Hannah Rowe is the last batter in.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! New Zealand Women are in danger of getting all out inside 50 overs now. Goswami delivers it on a length and in the zone outside off, Halliday tries to flash it through the line but it takes a thick outside edge and goes into the gloves of Richa Ghosh.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Jhulan Goswami

Commentary.Commentary: Spinning away from around off, Jess plays inside the line and runs it down past short third man for two.
Shorter outside off, tapped down to short third an for one.
Fuller and around off, Kerr drives it through covers for a single.
Jess Kerr is the new batter in.

OUT! Yet another wicket falls in the end overs. 5 wickets have gone down in no time - a bit of a collapse for New Zealand Women. Flatter and shorter outside off, Hayley Jensen steps back to make room and then smashes it through the line. It's aerial but the elevation is not there to clear the infield. Mithali Raj takes another catch at extra cover.
Commentary.Howout: c Mithali Raj b Rajeshwari Gayakwad

Commentary.Commentary: Mid off comes up and the cover fielder drops back.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! Short in length on off, Jensen steps back to make room and whacks it through cover-point. No protection in the deep and it's a boundary.
Misfield! Loopy and full around off, Brooke pushes it to covers where the fielder fumbles and they take a run.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes back into the attack.
On a length and outside off, Hayley hits it in front of square on the off side. The point fielder misfields and parries it to sweeper cover. They collect two.
Hayley Jensen walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another vital breakthrough for India Women. Jhulan Goswami angles across a length ball, a bit on the slower side, Amy Satterthwaite winds up for a big heave across the line but ends up getting a faint tickle behind to the keeper. Richa Ghosh collects, they appeal and the finger has gone up. New Zealand Women have lost the plot slightly at the backend.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Jhulan Goswami

Commentary.Commentary: Lands it full around off, Amy defends it off the front foot to covers.
Fuller and outside off, Brooke Halliday drives it to deep cover for a run.
Short and wide outside off, cut to deep point for two.
Swing and a miss. Back of a length, around leg, Brooke Halliday tries to pull but misses. Richa Ghosh fumbles yet again and they take a couple of byes.
On the pads, eased in the gap at mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fuller again, around off, driven back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, pushed to covers for a single.
Brooke Halliday walks out to bat.

OUT! Run out! Pooja Vastrakar has done a great job there. Fuller and around off, Amy Satterthwaite scuffs her shot off the inner edge and it rolls beside the surface. They attempt to steal a run and Pooja Vastrakar rushes to her left to collect the ball. She dives forward as she releases the throw and scores a direct hit at the striker's end to find Katey Martin short. The third umpire is referred and the replays confirm the fall of the 6th wicket. India Women are finishing strongly.

Is that a run out? Brilliant effort from Pooja Vastrakar to score a direct hit at the striker's end. The decision has been sent upstiars and Katey Martin has to walk back as she is well short of her crease.
FOUR! Well timed and placed Short and around middle, Amy Satterthwaite gets one in her zone and lofts it over mid-wicket for a glorious boundary.
Fuller and around off, off pace, Amy Satterthwaite drives but finds the cover fielder.
Short and outside off, cut to backward point for a quick run. 10 from the over, Jhulan Goswami has been ordinary this afternoon.
Slower one, full and around off, Martin tries to heave it over the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It deflects to covers and they cross.
FOUR! Shot! Lovely use of the wrists by Martin. Fuller and around middle, angling down, Katey Martin leans across and whips it behind square leg for a boundary.

Plea for an lbw! Not given. Fractionally short and around off, Martin walks down the track to heave it away but misses. It clips her on the thigh pad and deflects past the keeper for a couple of leg byes.
On a length around middle, nipping away, Amy closes the face of her bat early and edges it down to third man for a run.
Width there, short and wide outside off, Katey Martin cuts it to deep point and takes a single.
Jhulan Goswami (7-0-39-0) is back on.
Again it's full and on middle, Amy Satterthwaite flicks but finds mid-wicket. Four dots to end a fantastic over!
Pitches it up and around off, Amy drives but finds mid off.
Fuller and on off, Amy tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Katey Martin walks out to bat now.

OUT! Lea Tahuhu holes out! A bit short in length, around off, Tahuhu aims to dismiss it over long on by taking a step down the track but it flies off the bottom part of her bat and Harmanpreet Kaur secures the catch in the deep. The ploy to send Lea up in the order didn't work much for the White Ferns. Pooja Vastrakar has two wickets now. It's a good period of play for India Women.
Commentary.Howout: c Harmanpreet Kaur b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: Pitches it up and around leg, Amy Satterthwaite works it through mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Fuller in length and around leg, Amy quietly nudges it behind square leg and scampers back for the second run.
Flighted and on off, Amy sweeps and beats mid-wicket for a single.
Advances down the track and drags it down to long on for one.
Loopy and on off, swept across the line but straight to mid-wicket.
Loopy and full around off, Amy Satterthwaite gets down and slogs it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Forces a full ball down to long on for a single.
FIFTY! Amy Satterthwaite has played a smooth knock here, off just 51 balls. Full and flighted around off, Amy top-edges her attempt slog sweep and it flies behind mid-wicket for a single.
Width on offer outside off, smashed to deep cover for one.
FOUR! Bang! Too full and around off, Lea Tahuhu attacks it with all her power and drills it through covers for a cracking boundary.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to covers.
Lea Tahuhu walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Massive breakthrough for India Women at this stage of the innings. Pooja Vastrakar finally gets a catch taken off her bowling. Short in length and outside off, Sophie Devine smacks it through the line but doesn't get enough elevation to pump it over cover. Mithali Raj takes an easy catch to end Sophie's short stay at the crease.
Commentary.Howout: c Mithali Raj b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten. On a length and outside off, Sophie pokes inside the line and misses.
Short and wide outside off, Devine slaps it to sweeper cover where the fielder fumbles and allows the second run.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this inning.
A short ball, outside off. Sophie Devine slaps it wide of long off and manages a run.
On a length, around off. Amy Satterthwaite whacks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted delivery, outside off. Sophie Devine drives it down to long off for a single.
Another loopy ball, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite slog sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for another run.
A loopy ball, fuller in length, outside off. Sophie Devine sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket but only for a run.
Tossed up, well outside off. Sophie Devine pushes it towards cover.
A short ball, outside off. Sophie Devine dabs it towards backward point and collects a run.
Full ball, outside off. Sophie Devine drives it wide of the sweeper cover fielder and takes a couple of runs.
Back of a length, around off. Amy Satterthwaite pushes it through the off side and takes an easy single.

DROPPED! Oh, dear! Another chance goes begging! This was a lovely delivery, full and just outside off, shaping away just that little bit. Sophie Devine looks to push it through the off side but it goes off the outside edge behind the sticks. Richa Ghosh is late to react as she dives to her right. She gets a hand to it but puts it down in the end. The batters cross for a run.
On a length, around off. Sophie Devine pushes it towards cover.
Good-length ball, around off. Sophie Devine steers it through the third man region and comes back for the second run. Excellent running!
Pooja Vastrakar comes back into the attack. 1/41 in her 8 overs so far.
Looped up, on a length and outside off. Sophie Devine rocks back and slaps it through the cover region for a single.
A googly this time, well outside off and staying a touch low. Amy Satterthwaite looks to push it through the off side but it goes off the toe end towards long off for a run.
Slower through the air, shorter in length, outside off. Sophie Devine drills it towards long off for a single.
Floated, fuller in length, outside off. Sophie Devine prods and blocks it out.
Fuller in length, around leg. Amy Satterthwaite kneels and sweeps it towards deep square leg for one run.
Tossed up, around middle. Amy Satterthwaite keeps it out.
Skipper Sophie Devine arrives.

OUT! CAUGHT! The party doesn't last for long after the century. Tossed up, full and around off, Suzie Bates kneels and powers it over mid-wicket. The connection appeared crisp but still doesn't have enough to clear the fence in that region. Shafali Verma makes no mistake in the deep. End of a responsible knock from Bates and India Women have a vital breakthrough at a crucial juncture. The 98-run stand has been broken as well. A good gesture is shown by Jhulan Goswami who pats Suzie Bates on her way back.
Commentary.Howout: c Shafali Verma b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, well outside off. Amy Satterthwaite sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Another short ball, outside off. Suzie Bates pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
A short ball, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite cuts it to deep cover and takes a single.
This time she comes down the track and eases it down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Tossed up, outside off. Suzie Bates fetches it from there and whacks it wide of the long on fielder for a boundary.

There it is! Suzie Bates brings up her eleventh hundred in ODIs! What an innings this has been from the opener! Slightly shorter in length, around middle. Suzie Bates stays back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run. Dropped on 13 and she has made India Women pay dearly.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Suzie Bates rocks back and this time she finds the gap through the off side. Two runs as the ball is stopped near the fence at covers. Moves to 99!
Three dots in a row! Flatter and quicker, around off. Suzie Bates cuts it towards the cover fielder once more.
Another ball, slower through the air, around off. Bates rocks back and cuts it straight to the cover fielder yet again.
Tossed up, around off. Bates stays back and punches it to covers.
Loopy ball, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite drills it straight down the ground towards long off for a single.
Poonam Yadav comes back into the attack. 1/33 in her 6 overs so far.
A short ball, outside off and turning away. Amy Satterthwaite slaps it through the cover region and takes a run.
Flatter and quicker, on middle. Suzie Bates pulls it to deep square leg and manages only a single. She moves on to 97 now!
On a length, on middle. Amy Satterthwaite nudges it to the leg side for a run.
Nicely played! Flatter ball, around middle and leg. Suzie Bates stays low and reverse paddles it past the fielder at short third man. The batters take three runs.
Floated, around off. Amelia Kerr sweeps it to deep mid-wicket and collects a run.
Tossed up, around off. Amy Satterthwaite chips it over covers and comes back for the second run.
An overpitched ball, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a single. She will retain the strike.
Deepti Sharma to have another go. Mithali Raj trying all her options.
Wide! Flatter ball, way outside off. Amy Satterthwaite leaves it alone and the umpire signals a wide.
Flighted delivery, on a length and just outside off. Suzie Bates stays back and eases it behind square on the off side for a single.
This is darted on the pads. flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off. Suzie Bates shimmies down and drives it to long on for a run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Suzie Bates cuts but straight to the fielder at cover.
On a length, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite works it to long off for a single.
Flatter ball, well outside off. Suzie Bates cuts hard but fails to find the gap. Had she left that ball it would have been a wide. 11 coming from this over!
FOUR! The White Ferns have certainly changed gears here! Tossed up, around middle. Suzie Bates skips down the track and tonks it over the mid-wicket fielder for another boundary.
Fuller in length, around leg. Amy Satterthwaite sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
FOUR! Top shot! Floated, fuller in length and on off. Amy Satterthwaite gets under it and heaves it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary. Excellent placement as well!
Yadav tosses it up nicely, around leg. Amy Satterthwaite kneels and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Amy Satterthwaite tucks it towards square leg.
Poonam Yadav is back into the attack. 1/22 in her 5 overs so far.
Loopy ball, well outside off. Amy Satterthwaite sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated, on a length, on middle. Suzie Bates skips down the track and drills it to long on for a single.

A stifled appeal for LBW but the umpire says no! Flatter ball, on a length and going on with the arm, around middle. Suzie Bates looks to whip it over square leg by shuffling across and she misses. She gets hit high on her pad.
Tossed up, around middle, Amy Satterthwaite flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Tossed up, full and outside off. Amy Satterthwaite fetches it from there and whacks it over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary. Brings up her 2000 ODI runs in New Zealand.
Flatter ball, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite cuts it straight to the fielder at backward point.

Drinks break. It's been a smooth sail for the White Ferns. Third consecutive 50-plus stand has given them a great platform to finish strongly. Suzie Bates has been the fulcrum of their batting and other batters have also rallied around impressively. India Women have struggled to maintain consistency and will have to bowl smartly at the backend to limit the damage. Rajeshwari Gayakwad, who dropped Suzie Bates on 13, comes back into the attack after the break.

A stifled appeal for LBW but turned down by the umpire. A length ball, jagging back in sharply from middle. Suzie Bates looks to play it across the line but she misses. The ball hits her on the front pad. Probably have gone down leg.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Amy Satterthwaite gets cramped for room as she whacks it in front of square towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Good-length delivery, around off. Amy Satterthwaite blocks it out.
On a length, around middle. Suzie Bates clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! AND AGAIN! Jhulan Goswami hasn't found her length in this spell. A short ball, around off. Suzie Bates hangs back and swivel-pulls it this time behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
FOUR! Slightly shorter in length, around off. Bates stays back, gets low and pulls it in front of square leg to collect a boundary.
Hangs on the back foot and punches it to deep cover for one. New Zealand Women are 149/2 at this stage. Can they double their score from here?
Gets down on one knee and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and on off, defended back.
Short and around off, pulled aerially but wide of mid-wicket for a single.
Full and flighted, Amy fetches it from outside off and slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Walks down the track and gently tucks it to square leg for a run.
Uses the angle of the bowler and helps it in front of square leg for a single.
Fuller and around leg, nudged behind square leg for a run.
FOUR! Whacked! Short and wide outside off, Amy Satterthwaite gets the chance to free her arms and smashes it behind point for a boundary.

Nearly drags it on. Goswami bowls it on a shortish length around middle, Amy Satterthwaite gets back to defend but it takes the higher half of her bat and drops in front of the stumps before bouncing over them.
Lands it on a length around middle, Amy defends it down on the deck.
Begins a new spell with a short ball, Suzie stands back and forces it to sweeper cover for a single.
Jhulan Goswami (5-0-22-0) is back on.
Flighted and full around off, Suzie Bates sweeps it to deep square leg for one. Yet another stand has blossomed and it's worth 31 runs now.
Stays on the back foot and eases it down to long off for a run.
Misses! Flighted and full, outside off, Amy Satterthwaite tries to sweep but misses.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to deep cover for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, full and around leg, Suzie sweeps it down to fine leg where the ball stops. Poonam retrieves and they take three runs.
Bowls it short and wide outside off to start a new spell, Amy Satterthwaite goes on the back foot and slaps it to deep cover for a run.
Deepti Sharma (4-0-17-1) comes back to bowl.

Aerial but safe! Loopy and full around off, Bates heaves it off the inner half over the head of the mid-wicket fielder. Sabbhineni Meghana moves across to her right from long on and stops the ball with a dive. Saves two.
Floated around off, short in length, Bates forces it off her back foot to covers.
Fuller and a bit quicker around off, Amy works it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Short and on off, Bates gets back and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Loopy and full around off, Amy goes down on one knee and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Short and around off, Bates goes back and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Short and on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for another run. 7 from the over!
Fullish and around off, swept to deep mid-wicket for one.
Slightly short and on off, Amy cuts but finds the cover fielder.
Tossed up around off, defended back to the bowler.
Floated and on off, heaved over mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Bosh! Short in length, around off, Suzie Bates uses the depth of her crease and hammer-pulls it to the deep mid-wicket fence. Perfect placement too.
Short and wide outside off, forced off the back foot to sweeper cover for one.
A standing sweep again from Amy Satterthwaite. This time she connects with the fuller delivery and sends it behind square leg for three runs.
Beautiful delivery. Loopy and outside off, turning in, Amy Satterthwaite tries to drive but it beats the inner edge and goes behind. Richa Ghosh fumbles slightly.
Gets on the front foot and pushes a full ball to extra cover.
Flighted and full around leg, Amy attempts to sweep without bending her knees and mistimes it to square leg.
Slower through the air, outside off and spinning away, Bates plays late and guides it towards short third man for a run.
Full and outside off, driven to covers to complete the over.
Floated off spinner, around off, Suzie walks across the stumps and plays it off her pads to square leg.
On the pads, clipped to square leg for a single.
Fuller and on off, knocked down to long on for one.
Flighted and full around leg, Amy tickles it to square leg and opens her account with a single.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Bates cuts it through cover-point for a single.
Harmanpreet Kaur (2-0-18-0) comes back to bowl.
Flighted and around middle, defended calmly from the crease. A wicket maiden for Poonam Yadav.
Loopy and full around off, Amy Satterthwaite defends it off the front foot.
Amy Satterthwaite walks in at number 4.

OUT! TIMBER! Amelia Kerr gets frustrated and loses her wicket. Three times she played the square cut but found the point fielder. This time Amelia tries to do something different. Flighted and around off, going straight on, Amelia Kerr shuffles across the stumps and tries to power it on the leg side. She is too early into the shot though and misses the ball. It goes on to disturb the stumps. A promising knock is over.
Make it three in a row. Teasingly tossed up, short and outside off, Kerr cuts but fails to beat point.
Once again cuts a short delivery but finds the point fielder.
Tossed up, slower and shorter outside off, cut to point.
Change of ends for Poonam Yadav.
Outswinger outside off, Kerr fails to drive and Richa Ghosh fumbles while collecting. A bye is taken, 8 from the over.

Shout for a catch, not given! Zippy delivery, shortish and wide outside off, Kerr walks across the stumps and tries to cut but misses. It goes closely past her bat to the keeper, there is some noise and India Women appeal. The umpire is firm as he turns it down.
Bouncer and wide outside off, Kerr allows it through.
FOUR! Amelia Kerr is looking in fabulous touch. Short again, around off and angling in, Kerr rides the bounce and pulls it behind square leg for a boundary. The 50-run stand comes up.
Short this time, wide outside off, Kerr slaps it behind backward point for two runs. 100 up!
Starts a new spell with a length ball wide outside off, Bates cuts it past the diving point fielder for a single.
Pooja Vastrakar (4-0-23-0) is back on.
Allows the ball to spin back in and then eases it to the right side of the mid-wicket fielder. 10 from the over!
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! Harmanpreet Kaur delivers it full and down the leg side, Amelia Kerr kneels and sweeps it sweetly towards the fine leg boundary.
Floated and full on middle, flicked off the pads to short mid-wicket.
Tossed up, around off, heaved to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! Bang! Loopy again from Kaur, it's full and around off, Amelia Kerr is a good sweeper and nails it in front of square leg for a boundary.
Loopy and full, around off, Kerr moves across the stumps and defends.
A bit quicker, on a length, around off. Amelia Kerr flat-bats it to long off and collects a run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Amelia Kerr cuts it towards the fielder at extra cover.
Tossed up, around middle. Amelia Kerr works it towards mid on. No run there!
Another ball, shorter in length and outside off. Suzie Bates cuts it through the cover region and manages only a run.
A short ball, outside off. Amelia Kerr cuts it in front of square on the off side and takes a single.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Amelia Kerr skips down and drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Amelia Kerr nudges it to the leg side and takes a run. She retains the strike.
Fuller in length, outside off. Suzie Bates sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! What a way to bring up your fifty! Slower through the air, on a fuller length, around off. Bates dances down the track and heaves it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary. Top innings so far from her! She was dropped on 13 by Rajeshwari Gayakwad and is making India Women pay for it.
Another ball, full and on middle. Amelia Kerr clips it towards long on and hands the strike back to Suzie Bates.
Tossed up, on middle, Suzie Bates works it down to long on for a run.
Spin straightaway for Kaur! Flatter ball, around off and turning in late. Suzie Bates stays back and blocks it out.
Harmanpreet Kaur has been given the ball. She bowls very rarely these days but is quite handy.
This is drifting onto the pads. Amelia Kerr gets down on her knee and sweeps it to fine leg for a couple of runs. 8 from the over!

FOUR! Lovely use of the feet and it races away to the fence! Tossed up, around off. Kerr skips down and just eases it past the mid on fielder for a boundary. Suzie Bates did well there to make space for the shot.
Looped up, on a length and outside off, Suzie Bates cuts it through the cover-point region and settles for a single.
Flatter ball, outside off. Suzie Bates cuts it to the fielder at extra cover.
Another ball, way outside off. Suzie Bates looks to punch it through the off side but she fails to find the gap at covers. A dot ball.
Loopy ball, well outside off. Amelia Kerr cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Poonam Yadav to bowl her leggies now.
Fuller in length, outside off. Suzie Bates cuts it towards cover-point and there is a half-stop there.
Flatter ball, on the pads. Suzie Bates works it to the deep square leg region and comes back for the second run. Good running!
Uppish but safe! Tossed up, a full toss on off. Amelia Kerr comes down the track and just chips it uppishly towards mid on. The ball lands just wide of the fielder and the batter takes a run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Suzie Bates cuts it past the diving fielder at covers for a run.
Flatter ball, around off. Suzie Bates gets low and reverse sweeps it behind square on the off side for a couple of runs.
Flighted ball, around middle and leg. Suzie Bates whips it towards mid-wicket.
Floated, fuller in length, around off. Amelia Kerr drives it towards mid on.
Slower and fuller, outside off. Amelia Kerr prods and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller ball, around middle. Suzie Bates eases it to long on for a run.
On a length, around middle. Suzie Bates blocks it towards mid on. Harmanpreet Kaur intercepts with a dive from mid-wicket and stops the ball.

NASTY! Tossed up, around middle. Suzie Bates skips down and drills it straight towards Amelia Kerr at the non-striker's end who fails to get away from the line of fire. Takes a blow on her back and then apologizes for not evading the shot. Bates though smiles and checks her wellbeing.
BEAUTY! What a way to start off after the Drinks break! This is tossed up, around off and spinning away late. Suzie Bates looks to defend but the ball spins past her blade.

Drinks break. It's been a steady start for New Zealand Women. Their openers laid a good strong platform and Suzie Bates is looking in fine touch. The pacers of the India Women didn't threaten much and a few half-chances were also not taken. Still, their spinners have managed to restrict the scoring rate in the last few overs. Let's see how the middle phase pans out.

FOUR! Amelia Kerr breaks the shackles! Deepti Sharma serves a flighted delivery, fuller in length, around off. Kerr gets down on her knee and sweeps it in front of square leg to fetch herself a boundary. There was a fielder in the deep, it's Shafali Verma but she had no chance.
Flatter ball, around middle and leg. Amelia Kerr tucks it towards mid-wicket.
An overpitched ball, around middle. Suzie Bates skips down and drives it down the ground towards long on for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Suzie Bates lunges forward to block it.
Floated, outside off. Amelia Kerr moves across in her crease and nudges it to the leg side for a run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Suzie Bates rocks back and cuts it through the cover region. Initially, the call was for two but they settle for a single in the end.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad tosses it up nicely, around off. Amelia Kerr presses forward and keeps it out. Tidy stuff, the Indian spinners have pulled things back.
Slower through the air, around off. Kerr prods to defend it.
Flighted ball, around off. Amelia Kerr blocks it out watchfully.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Amelia Kerr cuts it but straight to the fielder at backward point.
Flatter ball, on a length and outside off. Suzie Bates cuts it towards deep cover and takes a single.
A bit quicker, around off. Suzie Bates punches it towards covers.
Tossed up, around middle. Amelia Kerr pushes it towards mid on. End of a successful over for India Women!
Slower and just outside off. Amelia Kerr is solid in her defense yet again.
Flatter and quicker, around off. Amelia Kerr stays back and defends it.
Tossed up, outside off. Amelia Kerr blocks it off the front foot.
Amelia Kerr walks in next at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Deepti Sharma strikes and this is a much-needed breakthrough for the tourists! She tosses it up nicely, on a fuller length and just outside off. Maddy Green steps out a bit and looks for a booming drive through covers. But it goes off the outside edge, straight to Yastika Bhatia at first slip who takes a sharp catch. New Zealand Women lose their first wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Yastika Bhatia b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Loopy ball, outside off. Suzie Bates leans into her cover drive and once again there is a half-stop inside the ring. A single taken.
Looped up, on a fuller length, around off. Maddy Green prods and blocks it out.
This is darted on the pads. Suzie Bates nudges it towards mid-wicket where the fielder fumbles and the batters sneak in a run.
A bit quicker through the air, around off. Suzie Bates stays back and punches hard towards cover. Not in the gap though.
Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. Suzie Bates punches it towards the cover fielder.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Maddy Green rocks back and cuts it behind point for a run.
Tossed up, around off. Maddy Green keeps it out.
Full and on middle, knocked down to long on for one.
Flatter and around off, Suzie Bates smacks it towards covers where the fielder dives and makes a partial stop. It rolls to mid off and they cross for a run. 50 up for the White Ferns!
Slower and fuller, around middle, Suzie Bates works it towards the mid-wicket fielder who half-stops it.
Flatter ball, around middle. Maddy Green tucks it to the leg side and collects a run.
Another ball, fuller in length, around middle, Maddy Green pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Tosses it up, outside off. Maddy Green drives it to the fielder at covers.
End of Powerplay 1! India Women can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the ring till the 40th over. Deepti Sharma comes to bowl now.
Collision! Flighted and around off, Bates drives it back and the bowler collides with the non-striker while trying to stop the ball. No harm done.

SAFE! Tossed up, full and on middle, Bates goes back and works it towards mid-wicket. She looks for a run but is sent back. Kaur scores a direct hit at the striker's end and it's referred upstairs. The replays show that the dive has saved Bates.

Is that a run out? A direct hit from Harmanpreet Kaur at the striker's end and Suzie Bates could be in trouble. The decision is sent upstairs and replays roll in. It suggests that Bates had just made it home.
Flighted and a bit short on off, Bates goes back and plays it down to covers.
Generously tossed up, full and outside off, Bates plays late and tries to guide it wide of first slip but fails. The fielder there stops it with a dive.
Slower through the air, full and around middle, Green walks across and tucks it behind square leg for a brisk single.
Starts by dragging her length short, it's around off, Bates goes back and pulls it down to long on for a run.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes into the attack. She replaces Pooja Vastrakar.
Full and outside off, pushed defensively to mid off.
Sliding down the leg side, it's nudged to fine leg for two.
Smart bowling. This one holds its line after landing on a length outside off, Maddy flirts inside the line and misses.
BEAUTY! A sizzling inswinger from Jhulan. It lands on a fuller length around off and nips back in viciously. Green tries to play straight but misses and it flies over the stumps.
Serves it on a length and around off, Green hangs back and plays it down to point.
Fuller and outside off, Green pushes it from the back foot to covers and screams 'wait on'.
Uses her feet again and eases a full ball down to mid on from the inner half of the bat.
Too full in length and outside off, Bates walks down the track and pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Good improvisation from Bates. She uses her feet to attack the short ball and pulls it solidly behind square leg. No chance for the deep mid-wicket fielder to cut it off.
Closer to off, on a length and angling in, Bates defends it off the back foot to the off side. Both batters have a chat.
Pitches it up and around off, Bates drives it down the ground again but finds the same mid off fielder.
Fuller and wider outside off, Bates drives it off the front foot to mid off.
Drifting down the leg side, Bates tries to work it around but misses. It clips her pads and rolls wide of the keeper. They cross for a leg bye.
Fuller this time, good areas, around off, Bates is forward in defense.
Back of a length, around off and shaping away, Suzie Bates defends it with an angled bat to point.
Outswinger this time, short and outside off, Bates steers it through point and collects a couple of runs.
Inswinger, on off and a bit on the shorter side, Green plays late and eases it wide of backward point for another single.
Lands it on a length and around off, shaping away, Bates plays close to her body and taps it down to the left side of the backward point fielder. They cross for a run.

Excellent piece of fielding! Short in length and around off, Green pulls it powerfully to the left of the deep mid-wicket fielder. The debut girl, Sabbhineni Meghana, dives across to her left and stops the racing ball, saving two runs for her side.
An off cutter, landing full around off, Green defends it near her front pad. Solid, again.
On a length and close to off, Green is solidly behind the line as she defends it to the off side.
Lovely placement. Fuller in length and outside off, Bates reaches out and strokes it through covers for three runs.
Slower one, a touch short and around off, Suzie goes on the back foot and plays a mistimed punch back towards the bowler.
Too full in length and outside off, Suzie Bates digs it out to covers.
Soft outside edge. Good length, around off and a hint of away movement, Suze pushes inside the line and edges it wide of second slip. One more run added to the total.
Short and around off, Bates walks forward and drags it in front of square leg. The fielder is a bit lazy and they collect a couple.
In the channel outside off, played down from the crease to covers.

False shot! Jhulan pitches it up and outside off, Bates slices her drive through cover-point. Two fielders converge near the boundary, some miscommunication between them but eventually one of them picks up the ball. Two runs taken.
Again there is room outside off, short in length, Bates chops it past backward point and collects a couple of runs.
Some room outside off, short in length, it's guided down to third man for a run.
Very full again, outside off, Bates tries to dig it out but misses.

EDGED BUT SAFE! Too full and wide outside off, Green tries to squeeze it out but gets an outside edge. It flies past the diving keeper and goes to third man. Poonam Yadav retrieves it from the deep and the batters take three runs.
Width there, outside off, Green steers it through the line but finds the backward point fielder.

PUT DOWN! That could be very costly. Short in length and wide outside off, Suzie Bates slaps it aerially to backward point where Rajeshwari Gayakwad tries to catch it over her head but it bursts through. She ends up tipping it behind and the batters cross.
Almost chops it on. Not short enough to pull, Bates tries to fetch and pull but gets an inside edge onto her pads.
Movement there as Pooja Vastrakar pitches it full and around off, Green inside-edges her attempted drive behind square leg and steals a single.
Slightly behind a good length, outside off, Suzie keeps it out to point.
Fuller and around off, defended from the crease to the off side.

FOUR! Suzie Bates loves her shot square of the wicket on either side. Goswami goes short and the line is very straight, Bates rides the bounce and pulls it to the deep square leg. Immediately after erring in line and length, Jhulan Goswami grunts in disappointment.
Gets on the front foot and pushes it towards covers. Slight fumble from a fielder inside the ring and they take a single.
Fuller in length around off, defended.

Nearly drags it on. Some extra bounce there for Jhulan Goswami as she serves it on a length close to off, Green attempts to play it square but it takes the splice of her bat and drops near the stumps.
On a good length, just outside off, Bates tries to play late but bottom-edges it near the surface. 9 from the second over.

FOUR! Smashed! Poor length from Pooja Vastrakar. She should be looking to pitch it up with some movement available. Suzie Bates fetches a short ball from wide outside off and pulls it powerfully to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Extra bounce. On a fuller length around off, Suzie Bates takes her bottom hand off the handle as she attempts to defend it.

This one is delivered on a length and outside off, Suzie drives it square of the wicket on the off side and the point fielder dives across to her right to make a partial stop. Shafali Verma collects the loose ball coming in from cover-point, has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
FOUR! First boundary of the match. Short in length, around off and angling in, Suzie Bates goes on the back foot and pulls it in front of square leg for a boundary. Straightaway, one slip comes out.
Wide! In the channel outside off, quite wide though and shaping away, Bates lets it be.
Miscued! Width there outside off, short in length and shaping away, Bates throws her willow at it but it takes the under-edge and goes towards the keeper on one bounce.
Pooja Vastrakar to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. Two slips in place again.
Fullish but the line starts from middle, Green works it with the movement behind square leg and returns for the second run. A quiet start from the hosts.
Some late movement again. Goswami puts it on a fuller length around off, Green tries to play straight but it takes the inner half and pings her on the pads.
Back of a length, around off and angling in, Suzie goes on the back foot and steers it through the gap between point and cover-point for a run. The White Ferns are underway.
A gem of a delivery! Jhulan dishes it out on a good length, around off and jagging back in off the surface, Bates stands back to hit it through the line but it beats her bat.
Pitches it up and close to off, a hint of inward movement there, Bates presses forward and defends it near her front pad.
Right on the money immediately. Serves it on a length and around off, Bates stays back and pushes it towards mid off.

We are done with the anthems and are set for the game to get underway! Before the players stride out to the middle, it is Sabbhineni Meghana who receives her maiden ODI cap from Mithali Raj. Suzie Bates and Maddy Green to open the batting for New Zealand Women. The veteran, Jhulan Goswami to start proceedings with the ball. Two slips waiting. Here we go...
The players of both teams have lined up for their respective national anthems! The anthem of India would be played first, followed by the anthem of New Zealand.
New Zealand Women (Playing XI) - Maddy Green, Suzie Bates, Amelia Kerr, Amy Satterthwaite, Sophie Devine (C), Brooke Halliday, Katey Martin (WK), Hayley Jensen, Lea Tahuhu, Jess Kerr, Hannah Rowe.

India Women (Playing XI) - Mithali Raj (C), Harmanpreet Kaur, Deepti Sharma, Richa Ghosh (WK), Shafali Verma, Yastika Bhatia, Jhulan Goswami, Pooja Vastrakar, Sabbhineni Meghana (On debut), Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Poonam Yadav.
TOSS - India Women have won the toss and they have elected to field first.

India Women are a good blend of youth and experience and with the return of Mithali Raj and Jhulan Goswami in the ODI setup, they look even more balanced. This ODI series is a perfect platform for the youngsters to seal their spot in the side ahead of the World Cup and it will be interesting to see the kind of combination with which Mithali Raj goes in the first ODI. Who will go 1-0 up in the series? We'll find that soon. Stay tuned for toss and team news.

New Zealand Women were clinical in the only T20I and they will be eager to carry on with that momentum in this ODI. Their batters will look to spend some quality time in the middle against a strong bowling attack of India Women. They seem to be a well-oiled unit, with some exceptional all-rounders but Sophie Devine would still be looking to polish some areas and take this as a very good opportunity to prepare themselves for the mega event.

Hello and a very warm welcome to the coverage of the first ODI of the five-match series between Indian Women and New Zealand Women. This is a very crucial series as far as the preparation of the World Cup is concerned, which is about to commence in less than three weeks from now. The ever-so scenic, John Davies Oval in Queenstown is set to host this much-awaited series and the opening game promises to be a cracking one as both sides will be eager to start off on a winning note.
